title_original: ‘Ebenezer’ Red Carpet London Premiere Photos: Johnny Depp, Rupert Grint, Tramell Tillman, Jedward & More
excerpt_original: Johnny Depp reunited with the cast of Ebenezer for the London premiere of the comedy-thriller at the Odeon Luxe Leicester Square. Joining Depp at the global premiere were Rupert Grint, Tramell Tillman, Sam Claflin, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, Robert Strange…

blocks.text: Johnny Depp reunited with the cast of Ebenezer for the London premiere of the comedy-thriller at the Odeon Luxe Leicester Square.
Joining Depp at the global premiere were Rupert Grint, Tramell Tillman, Sam Claflin, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, Robert Strange and Freddie Lee-Grey.
Also on the red carpet were director Ti West, producer Emma Watts and writer Nathaniel Halpern.

blocks.text: Other recognizable stars at the premiere included Minnie Driver, Big Brother UK’s Jedward and Love Island’s Ekin-Su Cülcüloğlu.

Depp stars as the unpleasant Ebenezer Scrooge in a reimagining of Charles Dickens’ A Christmas Carol . On one unforgettable Christmas Eve, Ebenezer collides with his past, present, and future on a supernatural journey that will decide his ultimate fate. If you think you know his story, think again.

Directed by Ti West and written by Nathaniel Halpern, Ebenezer stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, Tramell Tillman, and Ian McKellen.

blocks.text: Ebenezer is executive produced by Ti West, Adam Bohling, David Reid, Stephen Deuters, Jason Forman, Pete Chiappetta, Anthony Tittanegro, Andrew Lary, Molly Smith, Thad Luckinbill, Trent Luckinbill. The film is produced by Emma Watts.
The film, which opens in theaters on November 13, is rated PG-13 for frightening material.
